ideas.title: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of a Minneapolis resident by a federal agent, including potential wrongdoing by federal officials.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Was there any wrongdoing by federal officials?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and corruption, and could lead to major reforms in the way federal agents operate in local communities.
